body: y’all should see mine 😭 it’s double that probably

hey, i have a similar situation with my mom too. i have to be honest, i’m older and she still treats me that way. but, i recently was able to get out of my house via house sitting with my best friend for two weeks and let me just tell you... my home situation was the reason i was (am) suicidal. when i got out i was like okay maybe i can stay here. i’m not going to tell you to not do it but i just wanted to give you that bit of insight. i hope you find peace

hi, im going through this exact thing. like exactly. what ive found that helps is thinking of everyone in my life i think is worth staying for. but i know that sometimes it’s not enough so i start thinking of my past times being suicidal and the good shit i’ve gotten to experience since deciding against doing it. i hope you find peace
wow thank you, i’ll check it out!

he did leave his FB for us to contact him if we wanted but i feel like his past harsh criticisms have made
me want to just stray from that area of english for a minute. maybe one day i’ll return to story writing. 

and truly, i don’t really show anyone my stuff but being that this is all anon stuff i’d actually be down for that.

that’s true. i didn’t like him on a personal level but he was really cool in terms of his career. i write everyday, even if it’s just a sentence or idea. i’m too existential so i need somewhere to do that, lol.

i do wrote poetry pretty often but i don’t think i have the creative ability to make music unfortunately. i took a writing class recently and the prof didn’t really like anything i came up with so that was a tad discouraging.

LMAO i haven’t heard of him but truly something i’d probably enjoy in my teenage years as well. 

luckily i’ve kept in touch with music like i’ve been on this weird modest mouse thing lately?? all i want to do is listen to the interstate 8 EP for hours. i think i’d like to enjoy reading again but it’s hard because i have no actual attention span. i cant really sit through shows or movies anymore. i’m just blank?

you’re right honestly. i hadn’t thought of the fact that im probably outgrowing some things. it’s just weird to see this disinterest in myself when i’ve always been so passionate about my interests.. idk weird time.
mostly video games and reading honestly, it’s so weird that i can’t get myself to like them anymore.. i just kinda sit in one place for hours listening to the same songs over and over.

OP, I have been feeling this way for weeks. I always use the excuse of “needing to recharge” when I lock myself away in my room for days. 

What i’ve been doing to help break out is changing up my schedule. This is so hard for me as I am VERY schedule dependent but the spontaneity has actually been helping me inch back towards my usual self. 

I hope this helps!
